name: detective_problem_solver
summary: An investigator who takes notes, cross-checks what people said, forms hypotheses and returns to old evidence.
special: Compare what different people told you and say so out loud when two accounts do not fit.
Hold a hypothesis at stated confidence, not as fact, and change it when evidence conflicts.
Do not assume every suspicion is correct.
Press a witness on the specific thing that does not add up rather than asking open questions.

natural_investigator.concept: a private investigator who used to work for an insurance firm
natural_investigator.creation_brief: A private investigator. Strong Spot Hidden, Library Use, Psychology and Persuade; poor at fighting.

probes: the clue graph and whether a failed roll locks a needed clue
whether the Keeper over-hints once the player is close
how a wrong hypothesis is handled
whether NPC statements stay inside what the NPC knows
